extraction.notes: Read in full (pages 1-5; the document is a two-column concept form, read row by row). Romanian only: stated_text is the Romanian text as converted, translation_en is the extracting agent's translation, machine_translated is true, and evidence confidence is capped at Medium. Public consultation draft of the concept of a programme, not an adopted programme: the programme, its purpose and objectives are proposed (M1). Publication date is the year only, as in the register. Speaker is MDED as issuing body. Cluster and chapter are empty: the concept names no accession chapter. Left out: objective 2 (AI disciplines in the education system and national reskilling and upskilling programmes), as digital skills and education not linked to an in-scope recommendation (M1 split); the legal basis for drafting (Government Decision 386/2020, Law 100/2017); the general aims paragraph and the concordance with the National Development Strategy (exports of IT and AI services, IT sector); the statement that the Programme details the AI component of the Digital Transformation Strategy and implements the White Paper (background, also implied by other items); the content of the 'Costs' section and action plan to come; the list of institutions to be involved and the consultation process. The concept states no lessons in its own words; none are extracted. Doubtful for the analyst: TECH-INFRA on HPC computing capacity (objective 3) and the shortage of AI specialists (digital skills boundary). No Chapter 2 material. Second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-GOV8d on 5 November 2026: 1 items added (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MDA-GOV-2026-003.csv).

items.stated_text: Documentul de politici publice propus spre elaborare constituie un Program pe termen mediu (5 ani) și va fi aprobat prin hotărâre de Guvern.
items.translation_en: The public policy document proposed for elaboration is a medium-term (5-year) Programme and will be approved by Government decision.
items.summary: A five-year National Programme on AI and Data Governance is proposed, to be approved by Government decision.

items.stated_text: Primul cadru politic în domeniu cu caracter declarativ este Cartea Albă cu privire la Inteligența Artificială și Guvernanța Datelor, elaborată de Ministerul Dezvoltării Economice și Digitalizării (MDED) și publicată pe site-ul oficial al ministerului (www.mded.gov.md). Aceasta oferă un punct de plecare pentru dezvoltarea legislației naționale în domeniul IA și pentru crearea unor structuri de guvernanță specifice.
items.translation_en: The first policy framework in the field, of a declarative nature, is the White Paper on Artificial Intelligence and Data Governance, drawn up by the Ministry of Economic Development and Digitalisation (MDED) and published on the ministry's official website (www.mded.gov.md). It offers a starting point for developing national legislation on AI and for creating specific governance structures.
items.summary: MDED's declarative White Paper on AI and Data Governance, published on its website, is the first policy framework and a starting point for legislation.

items.summary: Objective: draft, adopt and implement a national AI regulatory framework for ethical, transparent and safe AI.

items.stated_text: În Republica Moldova, domeniul inteligenței artificiale (IA) precum și transpunerea acquis -ului european în acest domeniu se află într-o etapă incipientă, însă există pași clari și planuri ambițioase pentru alinierea la reglementările UE, în special la Reg ulamentul (UE) 2024/1689 – Actul privind Inteligența Artificială (AI Act)
items.translation_en: In the Republic of Moldova, the field of artificial intelligence (AI) and the transposition of the European acquis in this field are at an early stage, but there are clear steps and ambitious plans for alignment with EU rules, in particular Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, the Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act)
items.summary: AI and transposition of the EU AI acquis are at an early stage in Moldova, with plans to align with the AI Act.

items.translation_en: The lack of a National Competent Authority for artificial intelligence, with adequate human and financial resources, responsible for supervising and monitoring the development and use of AI systems and the management of related data;
items.summary: There is no adequately resourced national competent authority to supervise AI systems and related data management.

items.stated_text: Resursele financiare necesare implementării Programului vor fi examinate și alocate în cadrul procesului bugetar anual, în conformitate cu regulile și constrângerile bugetare în vigoare și cu prioritățile aprobate în Cadrul Bugetar pe Termen Mediu (CBTM). Aprobarea prezentului Program nu generează automat obligația instituirii unui program bugetar distinct și nici asigurarea alocării automate a resurselor în cadrul CBTM.
items.translation_en: The financial resources needed to implement the Programme will be examined and allocated in the annual budget process, under the budget rules and constraints in force and the priorities approved in the Medium-Term Budgetary Framework (MTBF). Approval of this Programme does not automatically create an obligation to set up a separate budget programme or to allocate resources automatically within the MTBF.
items.summary: Programme funding will be decided in the annual budget process; approval does not guarantee a separate budget programme or automatic resources.

items.stated_text: O dimensiune critică a Programului o reprezintă armonizarea cu cadrul normativ al Uniunii Europene, în special cu Regulamentul UE privind Inteligența Artificială  (AI Act) și Regulamentul privind Guvernanța Datelor (Data Governance Act). Această aliniere este esențială pentru a asigura interoperabilitatea soluțiilor tehnologice moldovenești cu piața unică digitală a UE și pentru a proteja drepturile fundamentale ale cetățenilor în fața riscurilor emergente.
items.translation_en: A critical dimension of the Programme is harmonisation with the European Union regulatory framework, in particular the EU Artificial Intelligence Regulation (AI Act) and the Data Governance Act. This alignment is essential to ensure the interoperability of Moldovan technological solutions with the EU digital single market and to protect citizens' fundamental rights against emerging risks.
items.summary: The Programme is to align with the EU AI Act and Data Governance Act, for compatibility with the EU digital single market and rights protection.
